system.description: You may take this ability up to three times (2nd/3rd instance costs 3 CSP). Each time, choose one adversarial condition: Corroded, Debilitated, Delirium, Hemorrhage, Jinxed, Nausea, Pinned, Paralysis, Pulled, Slowed, or Sting. When someone attempts to give you that condition, make your initial Trait Check against the effect at 1X advantage. Choosing the same condition each time stacks the advantage.
